lines.text: Your gingerbread contest, judged fair. Judges score five things, from one to five. Guests vote People's Choice. Twelve awards, from Grand Champion to Pretzel Architect. Kids, teens and adults each get winners. Fifteen pages. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
